label: D1 after an unrewarded trial while the agent still strongly prefers a2
explanation: Update-gate unit that is essentially an a2-side unit: 98.8% of activation mass is on trials whose choice is a2, it is never active when the a1 input or S1 state input is present, and 81% of mass lies in a moderate a2-preference band of the policy logit (choice in [-8.9, -4.4]); it is silent for a1 preference and weaker at the most extreme a2 logits. Most mass (79%) is at D1, and the strongest activations are at D1 right after an unrewarded trial (prev_reward 0, 82% of mass), typically after an a2 choice, when the agent will repeat a2 anyway. The recorded predicate (D1, previous trial unrewarded, policy logit still favoring a2 by > 4.4) uses only observed inputs plus the agent own policy; dev precision 0.75, recall 0.38, mass recall 0.63, and it covers 94% of the top-activation quartile. Using the upcoming action==2 instead of the logit gives similar mass (0.67) but precision 0.32: the unit does not fire on D1 after a loss when the agent is about to switch or is less committed (e.g. after consecutive losses). Weaker, lower-quartile activations at GO and at D2 on S2 trials (about 21% of mass) are not captured. Activity also depends on episode time (peaks at trials 30-60, near zero at trials 0-9 and 90-99), which no predicate explains.
